tools.name: conversion-intelligence_landing-page-dropoff-detect
tools.description: Rank supplied pages by measured exit rate from views and exits. Rates use only caller counts and do not claim why visitors left. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/conversion-intelligence/landing-page-dropoff-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: conversion-intelligence_checkout-funnel-audit
tools.description: Audit supplied cart, checkout, payment, and purchase stage counts. The largest measured drop-off is reported without inventing missing steps. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/conversion-intelligence/checkout-funnel-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: conversion-intelligence_event-coverage-check

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "conversion-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: conversion-intelligence_event-coverage-check · Public sink: conversion-intelligence_analytics-funnel-analyze, conversion-intelligence_landing-page-dropoff-detect, conversion-intelligence_checkout-funnel-audit, conversion-intelligence_event-coverage-check, conversion-intelligence_traffic-source-quality-analyze, conversion-intelligence_form-abandonment-analyze, conversion-intelligence_segment-compare, conversion-intelligence_diagnostics-report · Destructive: conversion-intelligence_analytics-funnel-analyze, conversion-intelligence_landing-page-dropoff-detect, conversion-intelligence_checkout-funnel-audit, conversion-intelligence_event-coverage-check, conversion-intelligence_traffic-source-quality-analyze, conversion-intelligence_form-abandonment-analyze, conversion-intelligence_segment-compare, conversion-intelligence_diagnostics-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
